body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself. Until your next turn, enemies cannot gain benefits for targeting you from concealment, Lock, or similar source-linked targeting states unless they are adjacent to you. After this resolves, you may become Unstable; if you do, this protection also applies against adjacent enemies.

surges.html: Move up to 2 units before or after resolving this Action.

rider.title: MIMIC ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Decoy Form. While maintained: The first time each round an Action targeting you fails, you may move 1 unit.
